set.body:
From S10.1b. Session folders keep the parts from earlier saves indefinitely. Decide on a retention policy (by design, or garbage-collect parts no manifest or journal references), and document it.

Current-state reassessment: the recorded implementation commit1bb152e0 and checkout are unavailable; no part collector exists in current ProjectSession/FileProjectStore. Return from review to open. Preserve the earlier proposed post-save manifest/journal ordering as design evidence, not landed source. Recover a patch if available; otherwise implement a reviewed policy in the owned checkout. Before collection, prove retention of current/previous manifest parts and every base needed by active or archived recovery journals (archives are not disposable cache). Skip collection when references cannot be established or journal reset fails; report collection failures without invalidating a successful save. Preserve inputs, run archives, journals and unrelated files. Qualify recovery, negative cases and mutations; no deletion occurs in this tracker-only task.
set.title: Project store: implement and qualify safe saved-part retention
